About the author

Cristina Liliana Calin

Why I do this

Cristina wrote her first story at seven, on her parents’ balcony, between the flower pots. On a tiny web sat a baby spider, so small it was clearly still a child, and she built a whole story around it. She drew on every page of her notebook and decorated each one like a real book.

She never stopped. Stories have always run in parallel in her head, through growing up, falling in love with books, becoming a parent, and every ordinary day in between. The question under them stayed the same: how does a person find their place, among family, friends and colleagues, without losing who they are? She learned to filter what she was told, and to walk away from places that were not healthy.

Becoming a parent taught her what no project ever could. Her child showed her, without trying, how honest, transparent and crystal clear we are when we are born, and how much of that we learn to hide along the way. In the AI era we have an extraordinary chance to grow back what is most beautiful in us as human beings. That is what this site and these books are for. More are on the way.

She writes for that question. Novels that let you rest and, on the way, help you understand people a little better, the ones around the table and the one in the mirror.

She writes in plain English, for readers anywhere in the world. Under the name Cris Calin she also writes and speaks about people and work, at criscalin.com.
